text: Slither analyzes Solidity source without executing it, pattern-matching against known vulnerability classes. It's fast enough to run on every single PR.
Here's a textbook reentrancy finding — a state write happening after an external call instead of before it. That exact ordering bug was behind the original DAO hack.
Mythril goes deeper — symbolic execution, exploring actual paths through the bytecode with unconstrained inputs. Slower, but it catches issues pure pattern matching misses.
crytic slither-action is the official GitHub Actions integration. fail-on sets the minimum severity that blocks a merge, letting lower-severity findings through without gating on every note.
Both tools catch known patterns — neither understands your actual business logic. Lesson 11 ties all of this together into one gate that actually blocks a merge.
